description: Frontend implementation - Complete React SPA with authentication flow, dashboard showing all subjects with grades and averages, inline grade editing, modal for creating/editing subjects (supporting composite subjects with configurable component weights), dark/light mode toggle, and pastel pink/purple themed UI.
steps: Create packages/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx - React context providing login, register, logout functions, current user state, and JWT token management (stored in localStorage with axios interceptor for Authorization header)
Create packages/frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx - Dark/light mode context with toggle function, persists preference in localStorage, applies 'dark' class to document root
Create packages/frontend/src/api/client.ts - Axios instance configured with base URL, auth interceptor, and response error handling (auto-logout on 401)

Create packages/frontend/src/api/services.ts - API service functions: authService (login, register, me), periodService (list, create, update, delete), subjectService (list, create, update, delete), gradeService (create, update, delete)

Create packages/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx - Login/register form with tabs, styled with pastel pink/purple gradient background, card-style form with rounded corners and soft shadows, input validation and error display

Create packages/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx - Main page showing: period selector dropdown at top, list of all subjects as expandable cards showing current average, within each card show grades table with name/value/weight columns and inline-editable fields, 'Add Grade' button per component, progress indicator showing total weight allocated vs 100%

Create packages/frontend/src/components/SubjectCard.tsx - Card component for each subject showing: subject name, calculated average (color-coded: green >= 4.0, red < 4.0), expandable section with grades table. For composite subjects, show each component as a sub-section with its own grades and component weight badge

Create packages/frontend/src/components/AddSubjectModal.tsx - Modal (using @headlessui/react Dialog) for creating new subject: name input, toggle for 'composite subject', when composite is toggled on show dynamic form to add components (name + weight percentage), validation that component weights sum to 100%, save button calls API
Create packages/frontend/src/components/EditSubjectModal.tsx - Modal for editing existing subject: pre-populated form, can change name, add/remove components for composite subjects, update weights

Create packages/frontend/src/components/AddGradeForm.tsx - Inline form or small modal to add a grade to a component: grade name (e.g. 'Solemne 1'), value (1.0-7.0 with 0.1 step), weight percentage. Shows remaining available weight
Create packages/frontend/src/components/GradeRow.tsx - Table row for a grade with inline editing: click value to edit, click weight to edit, delete button with confirmation, auto-saves on blur

Create packages/frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx - Top navigation bar with: app logo/name ('Promedio Notas'), period selector, 'New Subject' button (opens AddSubjectModal), dark/light mode toggle (sun/moon icon), user menu with logout
Create packages/frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx - Animated sun/moon toggle button for dark/light mode switching
Create packages/frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx - Route wrapper that redirects to login if not authenticated
Create packages/frontend/src/App.tsx - Main app with routes: / (DashboardPage, protected), /login (LoginPage), wrapped in AuthProvider and ThemeProvider

Style all components with Tailwind classes using the custom pastel palette: backgrounds in soft pink/lavender, cards with purple/pink borders, buttons in gradient pink-to-purple, hover states with slightly saturated versions, dark mode variants with deeper purple/navy backgrounds and lighter pink accents
Add toast notifications using react-hot-toast for success/error feedback on all operations
Create packages/frontend/src/__tests__/App.test.tsx with basic render test to ensure app mounts without errors
acceptance_criteria: Login page displays with pastel pink/purple styling and allows login or registration
After login, user is redirected to dashboard showing their subjects
Dashboard displays all subjects for the selected period with calculated weighted averages
Clicking 'New Subject' in navbar opens modal to create subject
Creating a composite subject allows adding multiple components with weight percentages that must total 100%
Grades can be added inline to each subject component with name, value (1.0-7.0), and weight percentage
Grade values can be edited inline by clicking on them
Weighted averages update in real-time when grades are added or modified
Dark/light mode toggle works and persists across page reloads
UI uses pastel pink/purple color palette consistently in both light and dark modes
Unauthenticated users are redirected to login page
Toast notifications appear for successful operations and errors
App is responsive and works on mobile viewports
verification: Run npm run build in packages/frontend and confirm no TypeScript or build errors
Run npm test in packages/frontend and confirm tests pass
Start dev server and verify: login flow works, subjects display with grades, averages calculate correctly, dark/light toggle works, modals open/close properly
findings: All 5 frontend tests pass. Full monorepo build succeeds (shared + backend + frontend). Added i18n system with English/Spanish auto-detection based on device locale. Added LanguageToggle component in nav and login page. Mobile-first design with touch-optimized inputs (font-size 16px to prevent iOS zoom, touch-manipulation, no-scale viewport). Added vercel.json at project root for Vercel deployment with SPA rewrites. The @headlessui/react Dialog uses Transition/Fragment pattern. React Router v6 shows future flag warnings in tests but all tests pass green.
